title: Zeng Shen Kills Pigs
simplified_paragraphs: 曾参是春秋时期道德修养很高的人。有一天早晨，曾参的妻子准备到集市上去买点儿东西。小儿子看见了，一定要跟妈妈一起去。曾参的妻子没办法，就随口说:"好孩子，你听话，妈妈回来给你杀猪吃肉。”
不久，曾参的妻子从集市上回来了，只见曾参正在磨刀准备杀猪。她立即阻止了丈夫。曾参却指着站在旁边兴奋的小儿子说：“刚才你出门时跟孩子说了什么，难道忘了吗？”
“哎呀，我那是骗他的，只是想让他留在家里。”妻子说。
曾参严肃起来：“孩子还不懂事，他的行为都是跟大人学的。我们承诺了却不做，那是在教孩子撒谎。”
traditional_paragraphs: 曾參是春秋時期道德修養很高的人。有一天早晨，曾參的妻子準備到集市上去買點兒東西。小兒子看見了，一定要跟媽媽一起去。曾參的妻子沒辦法，就隨口說:"好孩子，你聽話，媽媽回來給你殺豬吃肉。”
不久，曾參的妻子從集市上回來了，只見曾參正在磨刀準備殺豬。她立即阻止了丈夫。曾參卻指著站在旁邊興奮的小兒子說：“剛才你出門時跟孩子說了什麼，難道忘了嗎？”
“哎呀，我那是騙他的，只是想讓他留在家裡。”妻子說。
曾參嚴肅起來：“孩子還不懂事，他的行為都是跟大人學的。我們承諾了卻不做，那是在教孩子撒謊。”
pinyin_paragraphs: Zēng Shēn shì Chūn qiū shí qī dào dé xiū yǎng hěn gāo de rén。 yǒu yì tiān zǎo chen， Zēng Shēn de qī zi zhǔn bèi dào jí shì shàng qù mǎi diǎn r dōng xi。 xiǎo ér zi kàn jiàn le， yī dìng yào gēn mā ma yī qǐ qù。 Zēng Shēn de qī zi méi bàn fǎ， jiù suí kǒu shuō :" hǎo hái zi， nǐ tīng huà， mā ma huí lái gěi nǐ shā zhū chī ròu。”

bù jiǔ， Zēng Shēn de qī zi cóng jí shì shàng huí lái le， zhǐ jiàn Zēng Shēn zhèng zài mó dāo zhǔn bèi shā zhū。 tā lì jí zǔ zhǐ le zhàng fu。 Zēng Shēn què zhǐ zhe zhàn zài páng biān xīng fèn de xiǎo ér zi shuō：“ gāng cái nǐ chū mén shí gēn hái zi shuō le shén me， nán dào wàng le ma？”
“ āi yā， wǒ nà shì piàn tā de， zhǐ shì xiǎng ràng tā liú zài jiā lǐ。” qī zi shuō。
Zēng Shēn yán sù qǐ lái：“ hái zi hái bù dǒng shì， tā de xíng wéi dōu shì gēn dà ren xué de。 wǒ men chéng nuò le què bù zuò， nà shì zài jiào hái zi sā huǎng。”
english_paragraphs: Zeng Shen was a man of great moral character who lived during the Spring and Autumn period. One morning, his wife was getting ready to go to the market to buy a few things. Their young son saw her and insisted on going with her. Not knowing what else to do, she casually said, “Be a good boy and stay here. When I come back, I’ll slaughter a pig so you can have some meat.”

Before long, Zeng Shen’s wife returned from the market and found him sharpening a knife, ready to slaughter a pig. She immediately tried to stop him. But Zeng Shen pointed to their excited young son standing nearby and said, “Have you forgotten what you told him when you left?”
“Oh, I was just saying that to get him to stay home,” his wife said. “I didn’t mean it.”
Zeng Shen grew serious. “He’s too young to know better. Children learn how to behave from adults. If we make a promise and don’t keep it, we’re teaching him to lie.”
english_full:
Zeng Shen was a man of great moral character who lived during the Spring and Autumn period. One morning, his wife was getting ready to go to the market to buy a few things. Their young son saw her and insisted on going with her. Not knowing what else to do, she casually said, “Be a good boy and stay here. When I come back, I’ll slaughter a pig so you can have some meat.”

Before long, Zeng Shen’s wife returned from the market and found him sharpening a knife, ready to slaughter a pig. She immediately tried to stop him. But Zeng Shen pointed to their excited young son standing nearby and said, “Have you forgotten what you told him when you left?”

“Oh, I was just saying that to get him to stay home,” his wife said. “I didn’t mean it.”

Zeng Shen grew serious. “He’s too young to know better. Children learn how to behave from adults. If we make a promise and don’t keep it, we’re teaching him to lie.”
